subject.statement: Elizabeth Holmes was convicted of defrauding both investors and patients.

summary: Elizabeth Holmes was convicted in 2022 of multiple counts of wire fraud and conspiracy to commit wire fraud for deceiving investors about Theranos' technology. She was not convicted of any crime involving defrauding patients; patient-related issues led to civil settlements but no criminal conviction.
